game_title: Countdown Launch – Exit Light Ledge Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge, a ledge toward daylight: the spelunker must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Countdown Launch: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires.
theme: Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge: a ledge toward daylight
core_gameplay_loop: In Exit Light Ledge, repeat each round: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires. Each round, cave spiders strike the stone seal, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the count value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the stone seal from cave spiders in Exit Light Ledge: keep the count meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: count drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 67-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Countdown Launch
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how count changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cave spiders in Exit Light Ledge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 67 seconds while count > 0.
